title: A single exposure to altered auditory feedback causes observable sensorimotor adaptation in speech
reason: The paper pools/reanalyzes production data from six previous studies rather than collecting an independent primary recording set; admitting it as a source would double-count underlying participant recordings.
evidence: Methods describe a reanalysis of six previous studies totaling 131 participant records, with 40 individuals participating in two studies; public code/data are useful for lineage and derived-analysis reproduction but not as a new primary recording source.
lineage_action: Retain publication as a secondary-analysis lineage reference; link its component studies when individually eligible instead of ingesting pooled rows as new observations.

title: Sentences used in the speech-to-song illusion: Comparisons of acoustic vowel space
reason: Although the authors manually segmented word/phoneme/vowel tiers and derived formant measurements, the analyzed recordings are a selected stimulus collection drawn largely from audiobooks and a pre-existing UvA speech-to-song stimulus collection rather than a newly collected primary production corpus.
evidence: Methods report 77 selected spoken-sentence recordings derived from earlier speech-to-song stimulus sets; the larger collection was gathered from audiobooks. This directly conflicts with the database rule excluding third-party media collections.
lineage_action: Keep citation only as methodological background for segmentation/formant extraction; do not ingest recordings or measurements into the primary-production warehouse.

title: spINAch: A Diachronic Corpus of French Broadcast Speech Controlled for Speakers' Age and Gender
reason: The released vowel observations are based on Whisper transcription followed by Montreal Forced Aligner phonetic alignment; no exhaustive human correction of the relevant vowel boundaries/labels is documented.
evidence: Zenodo explicitly states that phonetic annotations were automatically extracted using Whisper then MFA. The public vowel table contains more than three million automatically aligned oral vowels with duration, F1-F5 and F0, but this does not satisfy the warehouse manual-or-exhaustively-human-verified annotation requirement.
lineage_action: Retain citation only as a large comparison resource outside the manually grounded core; do not ingest its vowel rows into the warehouse.
